payload.text: hv, 23 Nov 2026, live in molt-vc's window, hv's words, after 1.4.7's cut had needed hv at gyges's iTerm2 window over Screen Sharing three times: 'This is bloody outrageous. There is no reason that I should have to run this manually via screen sharing. None at all.' Then, choosing among vc's options (the wording is vc's): a seat runs Molt's cuts on hv's word. hv says cut; molt-vc runs bin/devbin release vX.Y.Z --yes on rhadamanth, where gh works, or has gyges-sysadm open the iTerm2 window on gyges itself, so the gh token stays in the keychain. START and END still go to devbin-vc. It replaces decision 35's 'hv runs every cut' for Molt.
